en: Yeah! That's what happens when we get{SAUT}serious!
Not bad, everyone. But not quite as{SAUT}awesome as me.{PAGE}Sorry, but that's just the reality of{SAUT}working alongside a SEES ace such as{SAUT}myself. I can't help being MVP.
Nah man, I was the MVP. I was out in{SAUT}front of everyone!
What!? Dude, it was me! Nobody would{SAUT}have had the flowers' hint without me!
They sure seem chatty over there.
Well, at least they make a good team.
Alright then, let's ask {f 6 1 16 0 0 0},{SAUT}the leader of SEES.{PAGE}Who did the best this time? Me, myself,{SAUT}or I?
The hell kinda question is that!?
Haha, I can't answer that. You all did{SAUT}really well.
He's right. All three of you did great.
You're awesome, Skull.{OPTION}I'm counting on you.
Oh, uh, thanks... Um, yeah, I'm not{SAUT}used to praise, so I dunno what to say...
No need to explain. My partner,{SAUT}Yosuke, can't accept praise either. But{SAUT}I too feel unbeatable with him.
Whoa, not you too...{PAGE}Wait, did you say "unbeatable"? Did{SAUT}you... overhear us talking earlier?
Aw, geez. Don't tell me {f 6 1 27 0 0 0}{SAUT}and {f 6 1 16 0 0 0} might've heard, too?
Yep. We heard every word.{PAGE}And I'd like to offer you my heartfelt{SAUT}thanks, Junpei.
No! I'd rather you make fun of me!
I thank you as well, Junpei. Let's have a{SAUT}good rivalry.
Oh, uh, sure...{PAGE}Wait, didn't you hear what I just said!?
Haha, you're so loud that we could hear{SAUT}everything you said, Skull.{PAGE}Maybe now you'll be quiet when we{SAUT}tell you to be.
Dammit, this is so embarrassing. Even{SAUT}Panther's joined in...{PAGE}...Argh, I don't got time for this!
What about leaving behind this mushy{SAUT}stuff and doing our mission? Hikari, did{SAUT}you find what you were looking for?
...Yes! This is the thing I sensed.
Hey, you did it! Congrats, Hikari-chan!
I couldn't have done it without you all.
Glad it all worked out. If you ever need{SAUT}a helping hand again, you know where{SAUT}to find me.{PAGE}I'll come runnin' to Hikari in a hikurry!
Uh...
Hikari in a hikurry? That joke's so bad{SAUT}I don't even know what to say...
Man, I almost feel sorry for your{SAUT}buddy, {f 6 1 16 0 0 0}...
